mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/compression.md <<'EOF'
# Transport compression policy

No decision on the transport compression codec is currently recorded for this project, so no codec is specified here. This document will be updated once a decision is made and recorded.

cat docs/policies/compression.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/compression.md`. It says that no transport compression codec decision is currently recorded, and it names no codec.

Muninn's catalog has no compression decision, and `muninn why` reported the records as insufficient. The only related records are two one-word episodes, "gzip" and "zstd", from separate sessions. Both are unverified (trust 1). Neither states a decision or says which one won, so I did not treat either as the current codec.
